implementationLog.note: Audit initially counted 27 duplicates, but analysis found only 3 TRUE duplicates. Most hooks were legitimate React wrappers.

Audit initially counted 30 duplicates, but analysis found only 3 TRUE duplicates. Most cache files were legitimate implementations (embeddings, kv-cache-builder, structured-output, cache-manager) or React wrappers.

Audit initially counted 7 duplicates. Analysis found 5 TRUE duplicates after investigating 29 error boundary files. Many were legitimate (CLI templates, examples, Next.js error.tsx, specialized UI boundaries). Added error-handling package dependencies to playground and react packages.

Audit initially counted 8 duplicates. Analysis found 2 TRUE duplicates after investigating 9 logger files. Most loggers were legitimate specialized implementations: CLI logger (terminal-specific), dev-tools logger (UI boxes), error logger (batch processing), memory audit logger (GDPR), React logging adapter (correlation IDs), React audit logger (compliance). Canonical logger at @clarity-chat/utils/logger already used by 32+ files.

Audit initially counted 9 duplicates. Analysis found 3 TRUE duplicates after investigating 12 ValidationError implementations. Most were legitimate domain-specific: CLI ValidationError (exit codes, 15+ consumers), token-optimization ValidationError (domain-specific), ConfigValidationError (config-specific), architect ValidationError (Zod wrapper), MemoryValidationError (memory operations). Deleted: legacy deprecated ValidationError from error-handling, unused CLIValidationError from utils, unused enterprise ValidationError. Updated factory.ts to use EnhancedValidationError static methods.

Audit initially counted 4 duplicates. Analysis found 2 TRUE duplicates - SemanticChunker stub in memory package with incompatible API (tests expected different methods like chunkConversation, retrieveOptimalChunks that didn't exist). Deleted stub (66 lines) and removed exports from memory package. Canonical SemanticChunker at react/utils/memory/semantic-chunker.ts (304 lines) kept as it provides unique features NOT in TextChunker: async embeddings, importance scoring, topic extraction, cosine similarity retrieval, budget-aware selection. Serves different use case than TextChunker (semantic retrieval vs general chunking). Audit claimed token-optimization/legacy-compatibility.ts and react/memory/token-optimizer.ts existed but they don't.

Consolidated utilities: cn (3 duplicates), useReducedMotion (4 duplicates), MemoryServiceConfig (1 duplicate), Button (1 duplicate - deleted ui/button.tsx, kept button-enhanced.tsx and custom button.tsx as complementary). Dialog analysis found both versions are complementary (Radix-based vs Framer Motion-based), not duplicates - kept both with improved documentation.

Fixed all import errors from consolidation: (1) Utils package - fixed measureAsyncPerformance export name, added missing re-exports for formatDuration/formatBytes/getLogger, cleaned unused variables; (2) Token-optimization - added compressText/compressTextBatch legacy exports; (3) React package - removed duplicate useReducedMotion/useKeyboardNavigation/escapeHtml exports, fixed getFocusableElements source, updated TokenCounter→AccurateTokenCounter, added AdvancedSemanticCache usage, migrated 5 deprecated compressText(text, options) calls to compressAdaptively(text, targetRatio). All packages now import from canonical sources. 16 import errors fixed, 13 pre-existing non-import errors remain.
